Execute Anonymous: // =============================================================================
Execute Anonymous: // ORG WRITE — converts a SLICE of the seeded [LOADTEST] batch to the Collections
Execute Anonymous: // Dispute record type, so the measured run is a MIXED batch: some rows qualify
Execute Anonymous: // for the migrated flows, most do not.
Execute Anonymous: //
Execute Anonymous: // WHY MIXED
Execute Anonymous: //     The non-qualifying batch is the incident, and it measures the floor - what
Execute Anonymous: //     every bulk save costs when nothing needs to happen. It says nothing about
Execute Anonymous: //     what the flows cost when they DO have work to do. A production bulk save is
Execute Anonymous: //     neither extreme; it is mostly inert rows with a minority that route. This
Execute Anonymous: //     makes the harness look like that.
Execute Anonymous: //
Execute Anonymous: // RUN IT SEPARATELY, NEVER INSIDE THE MEASUREMENT
Execute Anonymous: //     Changing RecordTypeId is itself a save that fires automation - notably the
Execute Anonymous: //     Escalation Router, whose entry gate includes `RecordTypeId IsChanged`. Doing
Execute Anonymous: //     it here keeps that cost out of run_bulk_repro.apex's transaction and budget.
Execute Anonymous: //
Execute Anonymous: // EVENLY DISTRIBUTED, NOT THE FIRST N
Execute Anonymous: //     run_bulk_repro.apex takes `ORDER BY CreatedDate LIMIT :EXPECTED_ROWS`, so a
Execute Anonymous: //     block of qualifying rows at the front would land entirely inside a 100-row
Execute Anonymous: //     run and entirely outside a later slice. Spreading them every Nth row keeps
Execute Anonymous: //     the qualifying proportion roughly constant at every point on the ramp.
Execute Anonymous: //
Execute Anonymous: //   sf apex run -o DevGss --file make_mixed_batch.apex
Execute Anonymous: // =============================================================================
Execute Anonymous: 
Execute Anonymous: Integer EVERY_NTH = 4;        // 1 in 4 -> ~25% qualifying
Execute Anonymous: Id COLLECTIONS_RT = Schema.SObjectType.Case.getRecordTypeInfosByDeveloperName()
Execute Anonymous:     .get('Collections_Dispute').getRecordTypeId();
Execute Anonymous: 
Execute Anonymous: List<Case> seeded = [
Execute Anonymous:     SELECT Id, Subject, RecordTypeId
Execute Anonymous:     FROM Case
Execute Anonymous:     WHERE Subject LIKE '[LOADTEST]%'
Execute Anonymous:     ORDER BY CreatedDate
Execute Anonymous: ];
Execute Anonymous: 
Execute Anonymous: if (seeded.isEmpty()) {
Execute Anonymous:     throw new System.IllegalArgumentException('ABORT: no [LOADTEST] cases seeded yet.');
Execute Anonymous: }
Execute Anonymous: 
Execute Anonymous: List<Case> toConvert = new List<Case>();
Execute Anonymous: for (Integer i = 0; i < seeded.size(); i++) {
Execute Anonymous:     if (Math.mod(i, EVERY_NTH) == 0 && seeded[i].RecordTypeId != COLLECTIONS_RT) {
Execute Anonymous:         toConvert.add(new Case(Id = seeded[i].Id, RecordTypeId = COLLECTIONS_RT));
Execute Anonymous:     }
Execute Anonymous: }
Execute Anonymous: 
Execute Anonymous: System.debug('===MIXED: converting ' + toConvert.size() + ' of ' + seeded.size() +
Execute Anonymous:              ' to Collections_Dispute===');
Execute Anonymous: if (!toConvert.isEmpty()) {
Execute Anonymous:     update toConvert;
Execute Anonymous: }
Execute Anonymous: 
Execute Anonymous: Integer collections = [
Execute Anonymous:     SELECT COUNT()
Execute Anonymous:     FROM Case
Execute Anonymous:     WHERE Subject LIKE '[LOADTEST]%' AND RecordTypeId = :COLLECTIONS_RT
Execute Anonymous: ];
